posts.title: A Hanafuda Koi-Koi App for Apple Platforms
posts.description: I’ve released Koikoi , an app for playing the hanafuda card game Koi-Koi on iPhone / iPad / Mac / Apple Vision Pro. There are no ads and no in-app purchases, and it plays offline. App Store / Website

posts.title: An MCP Server That Bridges a Resident Claude Code Session to Slack
posts.description: I released slack-bridge-mcp-server , an MCP server that bridges a resident Claude Code session on my Mac to a Slack channel. I send a message from Slack, the local session picks it up, does the work, and replies where I sent it.

posts.title: asc-slack-notifier: App Store Connect Review Status in Slack
posts.description: asc-slack-notifier is a server I built that receives App Store Connect webhooks and posts review status and build events to Slack.
